simple.meaning: נְצִיחַ (nᵉtsîyach) is a Hebrew word meaning “Netsiach , a Temple-servant.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נְצִיחַ (H5335) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:54, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְצִיחַ (H5335) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נְצִיחַ (H5335) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נְצִיחַ (nᵉtsîyach) / H5335 is traced through Ezra 2:54, Nehemiah 7:56 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
